# Editable BattleTech preconstructed decks

These links copy a championship precon into **Your Decks** in TCG-Arena, where you can edit, rename, save, and play it.

1. Load the BattleTech Trading Card Game custom game in TCG-Arena.
2. Click the desired deck below.
3. On TCG-Arena's import page, choose **Import** or **Import & Play**.
4. Open **Decks** to edit the imported copy.

> TCG-Arena currently tags imported decks for every format in the game. Use Classic imports with Classic formats and Resource Deck imports with Resource Deck formats unless you manually reorganize the deck categories.
